claims.reason: cancelInstall kills the detached worker and immediately removes tempRoot without observing exit/close or worker acknowledgement; the direct main.cjs failure path makes the race reachable.

installTunnelClient performs a final installation snapshot and then separate executable/manifest writes, leaving a real concurrent-edit overwrite window; rollback cannot preserve an edit already overwritten.

The source does not prove that failed connect leaves a running managed runtime. bootstrapTunnelProfile deliberately stops only after successful connect return and records failedConnectMayHaveWrittenProfile for manual recovery, preserving unknown profile state rather than claiming cleanup completed.
downloadFile exposes maxBytes and timeoutMs but drops both in the expectedSha256 branch, so authenticated callers receive the helper's larger defaults instead of their requested tighter limits.
Duplicate of review1 claim 1: the detached worker is signaled and its tempRoot is removed before exit settlement.

roots.title: Updater cancellation deletes worker inputs before worker exit is proven
roots.trigger: An update worker has been spawned, requestQuit returns failure, and main.cjs invokes cancelInstall while the detached worker may still be alive or preparing its transaction.
roots.fix: Acknowledge cancellation and wait for worker exit/close with a bounded policy before removing tempRoot; preserve the owned root for recovery if exit cannot be proven.

roots.title: Tunnel client install can overwrite a concurrent edit after its final snapshot
roots.trigger: Another setup or repair process changes the managed executable or manifest after the final snapshot and before atomicWriteFile replaces them.
roots.fix: Use an interprocess lock or ownership-aware compare-and-swap spanning the final check and executable/manifest replacement.

roots.title: Authenticated updater downloads ignore caller byte and total-time limits
roots.trigger: A caller invokes downloadFile with expectedSha256 and a tighter maxBytes or timeoutMs than the authenticated helper defaults.
roots.fix: Forward and enforce equivalent byte and total-time limits in the authenticated resumable path while retaining the signed-size hard cap and idle timeout.
